The '''Houk Syndicate Lair''' was a [[Cave/Legends|cave system]] in the [[Beastmark Hills]] in the [[Old Paths]] region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]. It was used as a base by the [[Houk Syndicate]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Houk Syndicate Lair appears as a location in the Old Paths on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
